title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Off Trade - Regional RJ/ES Brazil
description:
Job - Executivo(a) de Contas Off Trade - Regional RJ/ES

Com mais de 200 marcas vendidas em quase 180 países, somos a empresa líder mundial em bebidas premium. Traga sua paixão e use sua curiosidade enquanto explora, colabora e inova para construir marcas que os consumidores adoram. Juntamente com pessoas apaixonadas de todo o mundo, você testará novas ideias, aprenderá e crescerá e desbloqueará um futuro mais brilhante e emocionante.

Junte-se a nós para criar uma carreira que vale a pena comemorar!

A Diageo está em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas para atuar na Regional RJ/ES , com foco no canal Off Trade . Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo o desenvolvimento comercial sustentável por meio de ações integradas de sell out, crescimento de market share, iniciativas de trade marketing e gestão eficiente de investimentos.

O papel exige equilíbrio entre planejamento e execução: você será protagonista tanto na definição de estratégias quanto na atuação em campo, assegurando que as marcas da Diageo - como Johnnie Walker, Tanqueray e Smirnoff - estejam sempre bem posicionadas e com forte presença nos pontos de venda. Seu trabalho será fundamental para fortalecer a atuação da Diageo na região, impulsionando resultados e construindo parcerias sólidas com os clientes.

Faça parte da transformação no ponto de venda com as marcas mais icônicas do mundo!

Seu papel será essencial para:

  • Impulsionar o crescimento sustentável de uma base estratégica de clientes no canal Off Trade.
  • Planejar e executar o calendário comercial e as ativações promocionais, garantindo que nossas marcas estejam sempre em evidência nos pontos de venda.
  • Analisar indicadores comosell in, sell out, market share, sortimento, disponibilidade e execução , transformando dados em planos comerciais eficazes.
  • Atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento de ações no nível PDV, criando soluções de visibilidade com materiais promocionais e iniciativas que gerem impacto real no consumidor.
  • Gerenciar investimentos comerciais , assegurando retorno em crescimento e rentabilidade, controlar o fluxo de pedidos em parceria com o time de customer service, e apoiar os clientes na correta parametrização dos SKUs no ponto de venda.
  • Acompanhar e executar oJoint Business Plan (JBP) com os principais parceiros, o fechamento mensal de contas por cliente e visitas regulares para identificar oportunidades de negócio e fortalecer relacionamentos estratégicos.

Buscamos um talento com experiência no canal Off Trade, que já tenha atuado comclientes regionais, Key Accounts e Cash & Carry , e que conheça bem a dinâmica comercial desses formatos. É essencial ter vivência comgestão de KPIs e controle orçamentário , pois você será responsável por garantir a rentabilidade e o crescimento sustentável da carteira de clientes.

Valorizamos profissionais comformação superior completa e domínio avançado deExcel e PowerPoint , capazes de transformar dados em planos de ação estratégicos e apresentações impactantes. Além disso, é necessário terCNH válida edisponibilidade para viagens , já que a presença em campo e o relacionamento próximo com os clientes são fundamentais para o sucesso da função.

O que vai te destacar nessa vaga?

Umolhar atento aos detalhes e capacidade de manter o foco no que realmente importa, mesmo em cenários desafiadores. Ter umperfil analítico , orientado a dados e resultados, é essencial para transformar informações em ações estratégicas no ponto de venda.

Valorizamos profissionaisproativos , com agilidade para resolver problemas e tomar decisões com autonomia. Sua habilidade deinfluenciar e negociar em ambientes dinâmicos será um diferencial importante, assim como a facilidade parase relacionar e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Declaração de Trabalho Flexível:

A flexibilidade é a chave para o nosso sucesso. De meio período e horas compactadas a diferentes locais, nosso pessoal trabalha de forma flexível de maneiras adequadas a eles. Fale conosco sobre o que a flexibilidade significa para você, para que você seja apoiado desde o primeiro dia .

Your day at NTT DATA
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. What You'll Be Doing
Buscamos uma pessoa profissional Pleno que será responsável por suportar sistemas de automação de rede local e rede sem fio dentro do SLA acordado, executar changes, administrar e monitorar ambiente de rede, diagnosticar incidentes e problemas, seguir rotina de suporte.

  • Horário de Trabalho: Segunda a Sexta das 08:00 às 15:00 OU 13:00 às 22:00

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Suportar sistemas de automação de rede SDx (Software Defined Everything);
  • Suportar redes locais, redes sem fio, redes WAN, atendendo sistemas conforme SLA acordado;
  • Executar changes em ambientes “vivos e de alta criticidade”;
  • Administrar e monitorar o ambiente de redes;
  • Diagnosticar incidentes e problemas administrando redes complexas, incluindo dados, vídeo, voz e wireless;
  • Seguir rotinas de suporte;
  • Atuar em balanceadores de carga;

  • Cumprir SLA acordado entre clientes externos e internos. Semanalmente o gestor responsável fará reunião para discussão dos resultados e estabelecimento de plano de ação para cumprimento do contratado.

O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência atuando com Terraform e Ansible;
  • Protocolos de roteamento (BGP, iBGP, HSRP, OSPF,MPLS, VRRP, dentre outros), configuração e operação de ACL, NAT, VLAN, Spanning Tree, multicast, 802.1x e Controladores de política de segurança;
  • Experiência com balanceadores de carga (F5 BigIP e Netscaler);

Operador(a) de streaming / Transmissão ao vivo

Diretora de Receita | Gerente Nacional de Vendas | Gestão de Equipes | Gestão de Negócios | Consultoria Empresarial

A AGPNT Audiovisual está em busca de um(a) profissional versátil e técnico para integrar sua equipe para a vaga de Operador(a) de Streaming / Transmissão ao vivo.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com domínio técnico, postura profissional e atenção aos detalhes, capaz de operar equipamentos com agilidade e garantir transmissões estáveis, seguras e com alto padrão de qualidade visual e sonora.

O perfil ideal é alguém com experiência prática em transmissões ao vivo, tanto em eventos presenciais quanto híbridos ou 100% online, com familiaridade em ambientes corporativos e atuação em time técnico multidisciplinar.

Responsabilidades

Preparar, configurar e operar equipamentos de transmissão ao vivo (encoders, placas de captura, câmeras, mesa de corte, mesa de som etc.) em projetos internos e externos

Realizar transmissões ao vivo (webinars, treinamentos, eventos corporativos e reuniões híbridas) com estabilidade e qualidade técnica

Montar, testar e desmontar estruturas de streaming em campo (switchers, monitores, retorno de áudio, roteadores etc.)

Fazer testes técnicos com antecedência e solucionar imprevistos com rapidez e eficiência

Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes para definição de roteiros, fluxos e necessidades específicas

Trabalhar com plataformas como YouTube, Zoom, Teams, Vimeo, entre outras

Realizar captação de som e vídeo e controlar níveis de sinal durante a transmissão

Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de pré e pós-produção garantindo a fluidez do projeto

Apoiar na gravação simultânea (redundância) e entrega imediata de materiais, quando solicitado

Requisitos técnicos

Experiência comprovada em operação de streaming/transmissão ao vivo (mínimo 2 anos)

Familiaridade com redes (configuração básica de IP, roteadores, cabos SDI/HDMI)

Conhecimento em OBS Studio, vMix ou similares

Conhecimento em sistemas de captação de áudio (microfones, mesas Behringer, Zoom etc.)

Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas fontes de vídeo e áudio em tempo real

Conhecimento básico de softwares de edição (Premiere, DaVinci ou similar)

Diferenciais que valorizamos

Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Audiovisual, Tecnologia, Engenharia de Som, ou áreas correlatas

Inglês técnico para compreensão de manuais e interfaces

Disponibilidade para viagens (pontuais)

Boa comunicação e postura para atuar em ambiente corporativo

Noções de design de luz para streaming em ambientes improvisados

Informações gerais

Local de trabalho: Presencial, Rio de Janeiro (com deslocamentos para as produções)

Tipo de contratação: Contrato PJ, pagamento por diária ou por projeto

title: SEO Content manager - Brasil
description:
Are you excited about finding the best, fitting talents and releasing potential people to help develop Better Collective now and in the future? If yes, then you might be our new colleague as our SEO Content manager.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our content manager at Better Collective Brazil your key objective will be the coordination, production and optimization of content. You will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team working in our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

Your key objective will be the coordination, production, and SEO optimization of high class content that ranks in Google.

You will become part of an international, highly skilled and dedicated team catering to various user groups, in the broad field of sports betting and Igaming. You will take ownership and responsibility of the websites and products you are working on.

Your main responsib ilities a s a SEO Content Manager will be:

  • Coordinate the production of content for several of our top websites & create editorial plan

  • Optimize content for SEO

  • Perform keyword studies and develop strategies to address different user groups

  • Create new content based on business and market priorities

  • Manage requests to freelancers/writers, proofread their work and provide feedback

  • Regularly monitor KPIs (rankings, traffic, conversion)

  • Keep an overview of legal and competitive changes on the market

  • Closely collaborate with our business development team in order to make sure we have the best deals in place with our partners

  • Make sure your products / sites have the best interface, you will be able to collaborate with our CRO/UX team to optimize and push our engagement rate up

  • Make sure your sites are technically performing

  • Provide your own SEO insights to rank higher in Google .

What do we offer you:
Joining Better Collective, you will become part of a dream team of talented individuals that play each other well. Our workplace is a powerade of caring supportive colleagues who unite over ambitions, curiosity, passion, and our desire to have fun together. With our four company values Integrity, Respect, Ambition and Collaboration we thrive to be a company that is inclusive and a safe place for our employees, with room to be innovative and courageous.

  • International environment

  • High responsibility job where you will be able to innovate

  • A varied everyday life in a fast-paced international business

  • A lot of great office perks such as snacks and social events.

  • A professional yet casual working climate with very skilled, passionate and fun colleagues you can imagine

  • Competitive salary

  • Hybrid policy

  • Wellhub Platform - Wellness Platform

  • GoFluent - Language Learning Platform

Hiring model: PJ

Your way to BC
Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you want to know more about the job, feel free to contact Diana Figueiredo ( ). We look forward to receiving your application.
About us
We are a global sports media group headquartered in Copenhagen, with 20+ offices around the world and more than 1100+ employees. With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. For people that love sports, working at Better Collective is an opportunity to work on something you are passionate about and make work purposeful and fun. For those not into sports, a strong sense of sportsmanship is woven into the organisation and our core values, creating a collaborative, supportive, and fun environment.


Worry that you do not meet all requirements?

Don’t! We are aware that research shows that candidates often tend to avoid job opportunities if they have a feeling of not meeting all the job requirements. Let’s be honest: we don't check all the boxes either. In Better Collective we recognize that everyone is different which we respect and value and therefore, we encourage you to apply for the job, even if you do not find that you are the perfect match. Your unique perspectives and experiences can only make our company even better and help us in our journey to become the world's leading sports media group.


It is better to be equal
We are an equal opportunity employer and diversity is what gives us the little extra we need. We believe diverse teams help us make better products. We hire for cultural growth and welcome people of all genders, ethnicity, ages, stories, nationalities, religions, and backgrounds.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and the community.


Who you are:

You have a keen eye for online content: your editing skills can breathe new life into any copy and your writing is impeccable.

Your insights in analyzing marketing tools (keyword studies, Analytics and Search Console) and optimizing user experience have been tried and tested.

You can recognize yourself in most of the points here:

  • Familiar with betting and passionate about sports

  • Speak (and write) English fluently and Portuguese (native from Brasil)

  • Master’s degree within the fields of Digital Marketing, Communications, Digital Strategy etc.

  • Minimum 3 years relevant experience e.g. from a content role or in the field of digital marketing (including internships)

  • SEO editing skills, and flair for proofreading on a variety of topics

  • UX sensibility in web-products

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral

  • WordPress CMS experience

  • Team player

  • Ability to handle multiple projects at once.

Only CVs submitted in English will be considered for the job!

Expected start date: August 2025

Job Description
The FSG Finance Associate supports the Finance department’s day-to-day functions which include recording, reporting, and analysis of financial data, with a focus on creating value-added analysis to support Management in decision-making.

Job Description
The FSG Finance Associate supports the Finance department’s day-to-day functions which include recording, reporting, and analysis of financial data, with a focus on creating value-added analysis to support Management in decision-making.
What You Will Do:

  • Compiling and analyzing account information.
  • Prepare regular and ad hoc management information reports and spreadsheets, collecting, analyzing, and summarizing account information.
  • Accurately enter key data into our accounting and financial systems.
  • Maintain records and document financial processes.
  • Maintain an effective internal controls environment by following all FSG Policy and Procedural Statements, and requesting clarification when guidance is unclear.
  • Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis on an as-requested basis.
  • Analyze trends, revenue & cost, financial commitments, and obligations to predict future outcomes.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement and efficiency in your area of responsibility while minimizing risk and cost.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Advanced degree
  • One (1) or more years of experience
  • Professional certification preferred
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Knowledge of data privacy and security principles
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, budgeting, cash flow, and familiarity with accounting principles and practices.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report financial data.
  • Accurately and efficiently input financial data into spreadsheets or accounting system. Complete high-quality account reconciliations.
  • Technically proficient with financial and accounting systems and strong knowledge of data analysis techniques and data visualization tools and software.
  • Analyze large datasets and identify patterns and trends.
  • Communicate basic insights from data analysis.
  • Accountability / Reliability / Quality / Service Delivery
    • Ability to demonstrate independent, objective, open-minded thinking with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
    • Takes responsibility for his/her actions, behaviors, decisions, and results while holding self and team members accountable.
    • Meets expected levels of acceptable work quality (accuracy, completeness, & timeliness).
  • Communication
    • Listens and gets clarification. Responds well to questions. Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations. Writes clearly and informatively.
  • Employee Development
    • Completes all assigned and mandatory training on time.
    • Demonstrates understanding of tasks and activities as assigned.
  • Leadership
    • All levels of the organization are leaders demonstrated through actions and behaviors.
    • Act as a role model through positive attitude and behaviors.
    • Embrace change.
    • Ability to coach and potentially develop key skills necessary for leading the functions as assigned.
  • People /Teamwork
    • Actively participate in a team; engage and collaborate effectively with a willingness to support group goals.
    • Demonstrates respect for individuals. Recognizes other's viewpoints and ways of doing things.
    • Understands the critical nature of teamwork in achieving a common goal.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Systems.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to the Manager of Finance. This position does not have any direct reports.
About Us
We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

O que nos move?
Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Dito isso, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Produtor(a) de Transmissões para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Conteúdo e Transmissões no Rio de Janeiro . Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado.
Como Produtor(a) de Transmissões , sua missão será atuar nas transmissões de eventos, desde a preparação do conteúdo até a execução no momento em que estamos no ar. Impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.
Responsabilidades:

  • Pesquisa de informações e conteúdos relacionadas ao evento que estamos transmitindo;
  • Acompanhar e atuar nas transmissões ao vivo garantindo que o roteiro seja executado;
  • Garantir que todos os arquivos necessários para a transmissão estejam prontos;
  • Quando em externas, dar assistência a repórteres e coordenadores com as necessidades na arena/cabine/caminhão;
  • Suporte editorial para coordenadores e talentos.
Requisitos necessários:
  • Conhecimento de esportes;
  • Formação na área de comunicação;
  • Experiência com produções audiovisuais.
Diferenciais desejáveis:
  • Interesse por conteúdos do universo digital;
  • Conhecimento de outros idiomas;
  • Habilidade e experiência com ferramentas de IA.
Nossos benefícios:
  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.
Nossa cultura
Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.
SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre
Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.
SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos
Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.
SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande
A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.
O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO
Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile web, cloud, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.
Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.
What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Ubuntu Server is the world's most popular Linux - on cloud and bare metal. In this role, you will manage the team responsible for the software that manages access to all professional Ubuntu offerings.
This software runs on every major Release of Ubuntu and is regularly updated on all of them. To be able to do so your team owns continuous integration and verification across releases as well as a matrix of underlying platforms.
You'll be fully owning the product allowing you to influence its evolution and interact with many teams and partners to coordinate new features, enhancements and integration into various platforms.
The successful applicant will be passionate about the future of Ubuntu, mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and aware of the needs of large, innovative customers.
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader passionate about strong teams, open source software and Ubuntu. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
What you'll do

  • Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Work with Product Management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu and your team
  • Effectively set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
  • Oversee the quality of the Ubuntu Server image family
  • Plan and deliver Ubuntu Server features
  • Work from home with global travel for up to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have 3+ years of experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers. Experience managing distributed teams is a plus.
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills in english
  • you have experience with a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Practical experience with at least 1 of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Amazon Web Services
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
This position will support offshore project execution and brownfield modifications by turning engineering designs into practical scopes. It will involve project phases, procurement input, on-site commissioning, and troubleshooting. Projects & Execution

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design, and execution of offshore brownfield and debottlenecking projects.

Operations & MOC Support

  • Review and approve process input for MOCs related to plant modifications, safety improvements, or debottlenecking.

Education

Experience

  • Strong understanding of oil, gas, and water processing systems (separation, gas compression, water treatment, utilities).
  • Experience with process simulation tools (e.g., HYSYS, UniSim), PFD/P&ID development, and safety studies (HAZOP, SIL).
  • Familiarity with international standards (API, ASME, IEC) and E&P company practices.
  • MS Office package (mandatory)
  • Power BI (desirable)

title: Staff Wells Engineer
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil


Job Family Group: Wells


Worker Type: Regular


Posting Start Date: August 15, 2025

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals


Job Description:

What’s the role

The Staff Operations Engineer (SWOE) will support CWI Operations primarily for ORCA Development and other ongoing well intervention activities from DG4 onwards, operationalizing planning and design into flawless execution. The team will ensure world-class execution through dedicated support, implementing procedural discipline, QA/QC on components and vendors, and coaching to elevate the general level of operational competency across teams.

The Rig team is based both on- and offshore. The SWOE supports & works with both Lifecycle Engineering teams from Franchise Decision Point (DG3) to secure operations readiness and offshore operations teams by supplying dedicated expertise, coaching, and engineering support where and when needed as an integral part of the Operations group.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Report to the Well Operations Team Lead and work directly with the Lead Operations Engineer
  • Base out of Rio De Janeiro - Ventura Office, with an office-based role and offshore trips as required for critical operations
  • Operationalize the design and execution plans
  • Deliver world-class performance by embedding continuous improvement and standardization (Franchise) methodology as the new way of working to meet Well Objectives through strict adherence to Well Acceptance Criteria (WAC);
  • Support portfolio-wide technology development to improve field operations
  • Collaborate with Lead Operations Engineer, Lifecycle Engineers, Operations, and Franchise teams to develop and implement work packages from Well design pre-DG4 through execution post-DG4, and communicate learnings into the Franchise Flywheel
  • Support regulatory applications to enable spud and manage regulatory engagement during well execution
  • Perform final modeling checks against actual well parameters
  • Manage cost during execution as the Operations Engineer
  • Ensure continuous learning from rig-specific operations and share insights across the project team
  • Conduct vendor site visits with a focus on QA/QC during tool preparation
  • Support cost management during execution as a Staff Operations Engineer
  • Lead RCFA investigations and integrate Contract Management teams and the Wells Productive Time team
  • Manage MOCs supporting operational changes that do not affect the Well Basis of Design (SHALL/shall)
  • Escalate changes affecting Well Objectives or the Well Basis of Design to the Life Cycle Engineer for Management of Change
  • Support DWOP, AAR, and Well HO, and communicate execution-based learnings into the Franchise Flywheel
  • Integrate HSSE in the design, planning, and execution of operations; actively promote HSSE and Sustainable Development (SD) in all activities and ensure compliance with business principles
  • Support the development of procedural discipline
  • Contribute to Franchise development and implementation efforts within DW LoB as part of the Franchise System natural team

Operations:

  • Work effectively with the Operations Team to support execution and establish daily communication during operations
  • Integrate and liaise across disciplines to ensure safe, efficient, and effective execution of the work program
  • Provide routine and emergency technical input and support for all well-related activities, both in the office and at the work site as required
  • Supervise and ensure programs are executed safely and efficiently, fully honoring all company policies and procedures
  • Coordinate and support logistics to ensure operations are conducted safely, on time, and in accordance with execution programs
  • Ensure deviations from execution programs occur only with the appropriate level of technical authorization
  • Manage MOCs impacted by Franchise variations during execution under the accountability of the WOTL
  • Ensure adherence to change management procedures in the event of program modifications (MOC)
  • Conduct shop visits, audits, and vendor engagement with a Quality Assurance approach in alignment with Contract Management Teams and the Productive Time Team
  • Witness tool make-ups and tool loadouts, comparing actuals against plans to ensure successful field deployment (e.g., comparing schematics to actual HES Service Tool or WBCO Tools)
  • Proactively identify shortcomings before job loadout and coach relevant teams to correct them
  • Audit the maintenance of equipment commonly used to enhance reliability
  • Coordinate SITs as needed, especially for tools or rig-ups that are new or infrequently used
  • Discuss personnel requirements for the job
  • Ensure accurate reporting of all operations into EDM
  • Ensure accurate cost reporting and monitoring of all operational activities both in the office and at the well site
  • Participate in or lead After-Action Reviews to capture and share lessons learned from operational execution, in line with the GWDP and input into the appropriate WEIS funnels
  • Coordinate and facilitate AARs, closing the feedback loop through the Franchise Flywheel
  • Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis, working with the Productive Time Team, Lifecycle Engineering, Franchise, AWT, and vendors to close learnings and implement changes

What we need from you

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer
  • Must have 7 - 10 years’ experience in completions and well interventions operations with preference to smart completion deployments
  • Technical degree in Mechanical/Chemical/Petroleum engineering or any relevant engineering field
  • Design Experience with use of Wells Design tools such as WELLCAT, WELLPLAN, COMPASS etc. is an asset
  • Possession of (or ability to acquire) IWCF/IADC and Advanced Well Control certification as well as Tropical HUET CA-EBS (or BOSIET CA-EBS)
  • Commercial skills: Project management skills, a proponent of Strategic Cost Leadership, understanding of commercial implications of emerging ways of working, techniques, and technologies
  • People Skills: strong relationship skills and ability to influence and coach across the natural team
  • Be responsible for your own development and will execute an individual development plan agreed with the Well Ops Team Leader
  • Strengthening presentation and communication skills
  • Ability to work and manage across a diverse, multi-cultural environment
  • Maximizing value to the assigned asset while embracing HSSE and E&C standards

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .
O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar atendimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos especializados na área de Urologia, diagnosticando, tratando e acompanhando pacientes com doenças do trato urinário (masculino e feminino) e do sistema reprodutor masculino, promovendo a saúde e o bem-estar dos pacientes de acordo com os protocolos médicos e éticos.
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar consultas médicas em Urologia, avaliando sinais, sintomas e histórico clínico dos pacientes;
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames laboratoriais e de imagem;
  • Diagnosticar doenças do sistema urinário e reprodutor masculino;
  • Prescrever tratamentos clínicos e medicamentosos;
  • Indicar e realizar procedimentos ambulatoriais e cirúrgicos urológicos, quando necessário;
  • Atuar em cirurgias eletivas e/ou de urgência em ambiente hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar a recuperação e evolução dos pacientes no pré e pós-operatório;
  • Manter registros médicos atualizados e elaborar relatórios quando solicitado;
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, atividades de educação continuada e treinamentos;
  • Zelar pela qualidade e humanização no atendimento ao paciente.

Graduação completa em Medicina;
Residência médica completa em Urologia, reconhecida pelo MEC ou CNRM;

Título de especialista em Urologia (opcional, mas desejável).

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Linux devices software engineer on our SnapD team to work on mission-critical Golang code, focused on software delivery, containers, security sandboxing, telemetry and device management.
Snaps are next-generation software packaging and delivery for Linux. They are designed for safety, security and robustness, with application-specific confinement of containers optimised for IoT devices, desktops and servers. Our goal is that snaps work across multiple Linux flavors to ensure that publishers have the simplest way to reach the whole Linux world.
This role requires an obsession with quality and performance, for work at the heart of the operating system. It also requires an interest in the software publishing and consumption experience. Applicants should be passionate about open source software development. We value collaboration, peer reviews, good unit/integration testing and maintainable code. General knowledge and experience with Linux as a developer platform is required. Having previous experience with Golang is very nice to have.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or Americas regions
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Obsess over how to achieve robustness despite unexpected events like power outages
  • Work from home with global travel for up to two weeks, twice a year
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills, are thoughtful and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

DESCRIÇÃO
Para atuar nos serviços de saúde e compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital Municipal Evandro Freire – HMEF e à Coordenação de Emergência Regional Ilha do Governador – CER ILHA, na função de TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM.
ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO: Conhecer e nortear suas ações de acordo com o Código de Ética da Enfermagem, seguir e consultar o Manual de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) em sua prática diária. Chegar pontualmente ao setor, devidamente limpo e uniformizado. Realizar a admissão de pacientes na Unidade, instituindo todos os cuidados de enfermagem necessários. Realizar cuidados de enfermagem de acordo com o plano de cuidados, elaborado pelo enfermeiro. Obedecer à escala de remanejamento de funcionários, sempre que necessário. Obedecer à escala diária de serviço, elaborada pelo enfermeiro da unidade. Ler o prontuário dos clientes de sua escala, anotando observações importantes. Passar a visita nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando suas condições. Observar solicitações de exames internos e externos.
Preparar medicações e soluções endovenosas segundo prescrição médica e orientação da farmácia. Administrar medicamentos prescritos, de acordo com técnicas e horários estabelecidos. Controlar e monitorar os gotejamentos das soluções. Checar prescrições médicas e planos de cuidados de enfermagem. Registrar no relatório de enfermagem todos os cuidados prestados, intercorrências e sinais vitais ao longo do plantão. Auxiliar na preparação e execução de procedimentos médicos e de enfermagem. Atuar em emergências com a equipe. Manusear equipamentos utilizados na monitorização e tratamento de pacientes graves (conhecimento básico). Atender às solicitações dos clientes e acompanhantes. Recolher roupas utilizadas em hamper próprio e encaminhar material sujo ao expurgo. Checar a sala de equipamentos, mantendo-os conectados. Preparar e acompanhar clientes em exames, transferências, centro cirúrgico e outras necessidades. Preparar o corpo após o óbito. Manter o enfermeiro informado sobre anormalidades. Solicitar medicamentos e materiais quando necessário. Devolver pertences após alta, óbito ou transferência, conforme protocolo. Participar da passagem de plantão e de programas de treinamento. Outras funções pertinentes ao cargo.

Canonical is a global software company that publishes Ubuntu and open-source enterprise solutions for cloud, developer, IoT and AI. Ubuntu is the fastest growing Linux distribution and ranks as the number #1 OS in the cloud.
In partnership with Google, Amazon, IBM and Microsoft, Canonical helps companies become more agile, productive and adopt new technologies faster. Examples of customer success include AI, Blockchain, IoT, Advanced Robotics and self-driving cars, where Ubuntu is the preferred development platform.
The role of a Sales Development Representative at Canonical
Canonical is profitable and growing. We consider our sales development organization to be the best technology sales academy in the market, and as such, we select exceptional and ambitious candidates to join our team. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic, and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective is to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.
Click HERE to watch our SDR team discuss their role in Canonical
What your day will look like

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries across email, phone and chat
  • Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns
  • Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities
  • Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results
  • Work directly with marketing on campaigns
  • Research information about prospective customers
  • Generate a multi-million pound pipeline
  • Identify prospects and market trends
  • Help define the processes and policies for the team
  • Liaise with new and existing customers, setting up and attending meetings whilst actively mapping accounts to identify new opportunities
  • Accurately create, update, maintain and nurture leads on global opportunities

  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Verbal and written communication skills

In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per year

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Join to apply for the TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONAL - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Criar um ambiente seguro e confiável para que seja possível trabalhar a socialização e independência do usuário, bem como o seu protagonismo, levando em consideração o contexto de vida e projeto terapêutico.

title: Mecânico/Eletricista
description:
Horário: De segunda à sexta, das 8h às 18h com 1h de almoço
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Responsável por atender aos procedimentos operacionais para realizar revisões preventivas, corretivas e inspeções, garantindo a segurança dos passageiros.

Deve cumprir os procedimentos sob sua responsabilidade, conforme instruções de trabalho (PO).

Vistoriar os ônibus sob sua responsabilidade para detectar anomalias fora da programação preventiva.

Executar revisões preventivas utilizando a "Ficha de Revisão" ou de acordo com o ano do veículo, realizando check-list, troca de componentes como motor de partida, alternador, lubrificação do limpador de para-brisa, baterias, alinhamento de faróis e regulagem do tacógrafo.

* Experiência desejável na função pode substituir cursos de capacitação e escolaridade desejável.

Executar revisões corretivas conforme "Ficha de Tráfego" fornecida pelo motorista, incluindo ajustes em faróis, luz de freio, sirene de ré, buzina, visando maior segurança no transporte.

Inspecionar os ônibus na rampa verificando o funcionamento do sistema de ar, faróis, luz de freio, iluminação interna, entre outros, para detectar anomalias e fazer ajustes necessários.

Verificar anomalias nos sensores e reconhecimento do sistema de embreagem e acelerador usando aparelho "Multi Diagnose".

Inspecionar áudio e vídeo dos ônibus, verificando o som das poltronas e a imagem dos monitores, realizando manutenção quando necessário.

Atividades adicionais são realizadas por um Eletricista Jr, incluindo instalação de equipamentos de telemetria (câmera de vídeo, GPS, GSM), manutenção, ajustes e troca de equipamentos, além de conectar o fluxômetro ao sistema de telemetria para registro do consumo de combustível e manutenção elétrica do fluxômetro.

Manter a conservação, limpeza e organização das ferramentas, equipamentos e local de trabalho, promovendo ações de preservação ambiental.

Executar outras tarefas correlatas conforme orientação do superior.

Requisitos:

  • Escolaridade desejável: Ensino Fundamental completo.
  • Experiência desejável: 6 meses.

O cargo exige realizar atividades rotineiras com segurança e autonomia, sob acompanhamento do gestor, e orientar níveis operacionais inferiores conforme a experiência.

description:
VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA!
Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.
Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos.

• Criar tabelas e processos de ETL em SQL envolvendo delta de camadas junto com o Lakehouse através de procedures no banco.
• Criar pipelines e dar manutenção no Azure Data Factory para ingestão de dados no repositório.
• Integrar diferentes fontes de dados estruturados e não estruturados;

• Desejável experiência anterior atuando na integração de sistemas de RH
• Desejável experiência com streaming de dados (Kafka, Spark Streaming etc)
• Desejável conhecimento em modelagem de dados e Data Warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift etc.)
INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE
Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.
Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.
Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.
O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!
Nossa Missão:
Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.
Nossos Valores são:
• Jogo aberto e íntegro
• Foco em resultado com qualidade
• Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso
• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser
• Atitude Responsável
Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!
Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.
Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.

title: Técnico Eletrônico Junior
description:
In fast-changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security, and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Técnico Eletrônico Junior

This position is in a on-site model at our unit in São Bernardo do Campo .

Summary

The entry-level Electronic Repair Technician will perform basic tasks to develop fundamental skills. The technician will repair radar subassemblies, focusing on simple repairs of digital and analog electronic boards under supervision. Practical experience with test benches like Spectrum, S40, and basic programming benches will be gained. Additionally, the technician will assist with basic PC maintenance tasks, such as installing operating systems and client applications, under supervision. Initial steps in software configuration and hardware management will be learned through guided instructions. Cost estimates and quotations will be prepared under strict supervision, following internal procedures and quality standards. Entry-level technicians will receive regular support from teams, including methods and engineering, to enhance their learning.

Main Responsibilities

  • Assist in basic repairs of digital and analog electronic boards under supervision;
  • Use test benches, including Spectrum and S40, for simple tasks;
  • Perform basic PC maintenance, such as installing operating systems and client applications under supervision;
  • Assist in cost estimates and generate budgets with guidance;
  • Contact support teams for assistance and learning.

Qualifications

  • Experience in the electronics industry, preferably in maintenance;
  • IPC-A-610 Certification;
  • Understanding of basic electronic components and circuits;
  • Proficiency with multimeters, oscilloscopes, soldering tools, and other diagnostic equipment;
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams;
  • Basic knowledge of IT systems and software used in electronic repairs;
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to repair electronic devices;
  • Familiarity with specific test benches like Spectrum and programming benches;
  • Basic understanding of quality control and acceptance procedures;
  • Ability to follow safety protocols and standards;
  • Understanding of industrial challenges faced by the company;
  • Basic English for reading technical documents.

If you're excited to work at Thales but don't meet all the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Thales offers an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 30 hours or more per week and their eligible dependents, including:

  • Health and Dental Plans;
  • Private pension with company contribution and matching;
  • Life Insurance provided by the company.

description:
Job description

SOBRE A CAMICADO

Você já pensou em trabalhar em um lugar que atua de forma transparente, que inspira confiança e autodesenvolvimento?

Que tem o encantamento e a diversidade como alguns dos seus valores?

Se a sua resposta foi sim, queremos te conhecer!

A Camicado, é uma rede de lojas especializada em Casa & Decoração, faz parte do grupo Lojas Renner S.A. que é a maior varejista de moda do Brasil, foi a primeira corporação brasileira com 100% das ações negociadas em bolsa e está listada no Novo Mercado, grau mais elevado dentre os níveis diferenciados de governança corporativa da B3. Atualmente contamos com mais de 110 lojas espalhadas por 24 dos 27 distritos federativos do Brasil.

Diversidade é um tema de muita relevância para o nosso negócio e a sociedade como um todo, valorizamos e respeitamos as diferenças, pois entendemos que ela estimula a inovação, permitindo soluções e uma comunicação assertiva para os mais diversos públicos.

Aqui todos são bem-vindos(as), queremos ser uma empresa cada vez mais plural e diversa!

O nosso objetivo é formar o melhor TIME de encantadores de clientes sem distinção de nacionalidade, cor, gênero, religião, deficiência e outros.


Main responsibilities

VOCÊ SERÁ RESPONSÁVEL POR;

O Assistente de Produtos Financeiros tem a missão de atender os clientes no processo de comercialização de produtos financeiros, com compromisso total de ir além de suas necessidades, para fornecer soluções efetivas que o surpreendam, promovendo o seu encantamento.

• Encantar os clientes no processo de vendas de Produtos Financeiros, auxiliando sempre que necessário;

• Executar atividades relacionadas à área de crédito da empresa, tais como, liberação de crédito, emissão de cartões e prestar informações a clientes;

• Atualizar os dados cadastrais dos clientes;

• Responsável pela organização e solicitação de materiais de divulgação dos produtos financeiros.


Requirements and skills

PARA SER DE CASA E FAZER PARTE DESTE TIME VOCÊ PRECISA TER

  • Formação: Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência: Preferencialmente experiência na área de produtos financeiros.

Additional information

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ?

  • Salário Compatível com a Função;
  • Remuneração Variável;
  • Plano de Saúde ;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Desconto na Compra de Produtos das lojas do Grupo Renner S.A;
  • Good Card;
  • Gympass.

Se identificou? Então vem ser de casa e fazer parte desse TIME encantador!

title: Data Processor
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Data Processor role at UTEC

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Data Processor at UTEC

UTEC, part of Acteon Group, is one of the world's largest independent offshore and onshore survey providers. We provide a wide range of survey, positioning, and data management services using advanced equipment and techniques. The data we generate helps our clients make critical, well-informed business decisions.

UTEC is looking to add a Data Processor to the team. The Data Processor is responsible for onboard processing, QC, and management of all relevant acquired data, including hydrographic and bathymetric data, as well as the production of associated charts.

The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations. Periods of onshore support may also be required, working remotely or from UTEC offices or workshops.

The successful candidates will be based in Brazil.

Duties

  • Inspect the quality of raw data and inform the supervisor if data does not meet standards
  • Review survey logs compiled by data acquisition crews
  • Process acquired data sets using the company's processing software
  • Keep processing logs up to date and record offsets used during processing
  • Discuss processing requirements with teams and advisers
  • Manage time to prioritize processing tasks to meet project deadlines
  • Follow predefined processing sequences from procedures or supervisor instructions
  • QC datasets at each processing stage to ensure data integrity
  • Discuss requirements and final deliverables with the supervisor regularly
  • Adhere to company standards to maintain quality management systems
  • Create or amend charts as per project requirements
  • Participate actively and lead by example in the company's Quality and HSE systems and procedures
  • Understand and comply with UTEC policies and procedures
  • Be prepared to "Stop the Job" if safety or equipment is at risk

Requirements

  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English (strongly preferred)
  • Degree in Geomatics, Surveying Science, or related field
  • Relevant industry, military, or academic experience in survey disciplines
  • Satisfactory completion of competence criteria for Data Processor Grade II
  • Approximately 12 months of experience, including 80 offshore operational days as a Data Processor Grade II

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Associate
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Other
  • Industry: Surveying and Mapping Services

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at UTEC by 2x.

Are you passionate about social media and ready to take the lead in crafting strategies that make a real impact? Do you love staying ahead of the latest trends and creating content that engages and resonates with diverse audiences? If this sounds like you, we want you on our team!

At Rio & Learn, we’re seeking a Social Media Coordinator who will oversee the entire management of our social media presence. You’ll be responsible for planning, creating, and executing our content strategies across various platforms. In this role, you won’t just be behind the scenes; we need someone who’s not afraid to step in front of the camera and encourage our staff, teachers, and students to participate in videos as well.

Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.
We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.
The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.
Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.
This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.
What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You are a passionate Python developer
  • You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • You are a lifelong learner
Bonus points for
  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Golang programming skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Esse profissional será responsável pela estratégia e execução de campanhas em múltiplas plataformas digitais, garantindo que o tráfego gerado seja qualificado e relevante para as metas da empresa;

Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, criar e otimizar campanhas de tráfego pago em plataformas como Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, entre outras.
  • Realizar análises aprofundadas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e definir estratégias de mídia alinhadas aos KPIs do negócio.
  • Gerenciar o orçamento de mídia, garantindo a alocação eficiente de recursos para maximizar o ROI.
  • Monitorar, mensurar e reportar o desempenho das campanhas por meio de ferramentas de análise, oferecendo insights e recomendações para aprimorar os resultados.
  • Implementar estratégias de segmentação e remarketing para atingir públicos específicos e aumentar a conversão.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de marketing, conteúdo e design para criar anúncios que reflitam a identidade da marca e engajar o público.
  • Ficar atento às novas tendências e atualizações das plataformas de mídia paga, propondo inovações e ajustes estratégicos.
  • Testar e validar criativos, textos e públicos, realizando testes A/B para entender o que melhor ressoa com o público.

Qualificações:

  • Experiência como gestor de tráfego ou especialista em mídia paga, com resultados comprovados em campanhas de aquisição e retenção.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de anúncios como Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads e outras plataformas de mídia paga.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager e outras ferramentas de mensuração e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com estratégias de segmentação de público, remarketing e funil de conversão.
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) e SEO são diferenciais.
  • Profissional analítico, orientado a dados, com habilidades de resolução de problemas e tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Atualizado com as principais tendências do mercado digital e novidades nas plataformas de mídia.
  • Proativo, com excelente capacidade de organização e gestão de múltiplas campanhas e prazos simultâneos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação eficaz para traduzir dados e insights em planos de ação claros e objetivos para outras equipes.

description:
